content.tagline: Exosomes made in-house — from raw material to finished product
content.descriptor: A Korean biotech company from Yongin: plant-derived exosomes of its own making, the EXOLUNA brand — scalp care, a clinic line and activators for aesthetics
about: RNH BIO is a Korean biotechnology company from Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, specialising in exosomes. Using its own Multi RN-Exosome™ technology, it produces plant-derived exosomes itself. Alongside the EXOLUNA brand of finished products, the company supplies exosome raw material for cosmetics, aesthetics and hair care, and carries out product development.

The plant exosomes are produced by upcycling: the raw material is low-value agricultural produce and by-products of processing. The line-up covers exosomes from several plant sources, among them Japanese hop, coffee fruit, camellia fruit, peppermint, rice and seaweed. For a particular product and development task the company selects the suitable exosome material.

The main products are built around the EXOLUNA brand. The hair and scalp care line is RN-Exosome™ Scalp Booster Ampoule + Activator. EXOLUNA RX PRO is the professional line for clinics and aesthetic practices. RN-Exosome™ Activator, a freeze-dried product for aesthetics, is divided into a Basic Line and a High-End Line. Besides finished products, the company supplies exosome raw material, develops materials to order and develops products together with brands and manufacturers.
facts: Finished products and raw material alike
channels: Brands and contract manufacturers — as a raw material supplier

lines.name: RN-Exosome™ Scalp Booster Ampoule + Activator
lines.note: The retail scalp care line. A 60 ml ampoule and a freeze-dried activator, mixed before use. The company states a complex of four plant exosomes — Japanese hop, coffee fruit, camellia fruit and peppermint — together with biotin, amino acids and the functional ingredients MELTANE and caffeine. Use once a day in the evening.

lines.name: EXOLUNA RX PRO
lines.note: A clinic set of two vials: 2 g of freeze-dried exosomes and a 2 ml activating ampoule. A dual exosome system — milk and camellia fruit. The company positions it for use immediately after procedures, including MTS and laser. Stated purposes: recovery, tone, firmness.

lines.name: RN-Exosome™ Activator · Basic Line
lines.note: Two activators for salons. Brightening & Firming — milk and camellia exosomes, working on tone and firmness. Scalp Booster — Japanese hop and coffee exosomes, working on scalp and hair.

lines.name: RN-Exosome™ Activator · High-End Line
lines.note: Four EXONOVA activators for specific tasks. PDRN Repair on five-seaweed exosomes. White Glow on rice and milk exosomes. EGF Firming on camellia and coffee exosomes. Noggin Scalp on Japanese hop, coffee, peppermint and camellia exosomes.

tech.name: Multi RN-Exosome
tech.note: The company's own technology. Exosomes are obtained from plant material by upcycling, and they go into finished products as complexes of several types rather than one at a time. For individual finished products the company also lists milk exosomes in the composition.

tech.name: Freeze-dried plus activator
tech.note: The exosomes are supplied dried in a vial, the activating ampoule comes separately, and the two are mixed immediately before use. The format was chosen for stability: once prepared, such a system does not keep for long. For a buyer that means specific storage requirements and staff training.

tech.name: Results stated by the company
tech.note: The company gives the following figures. In an experiment on dermal papilla cell culture it obtained an increase in proliferation exceeding the result of minoxidil; it describes the component itself as 20–40 per cent more effective. HDF cell viability by the CCK8 method rose by 50 per cent with milk exosomes added. The antioxidant activity of camellia exosomes by the DPPH method proved 14 times higher than that of blueberry. Separately the company reports an AI-analysis test: after a week of use, changes in hair growth rate and in the number of hairs per follicle opening were recorded. All of the above is the manufacturer's own data, obtained on laboratory models and in its own tests. These are not clinical trials of the finished product on people. Permitted wording on a label depends on the market, and comparison with a medicinal product is not allowed everywhere.

tech.name: MoCRA registration
tech.note: The company states a completed registration under the US MoCRA regime for the RN-Exosome™ Scalp Booster Ampoule + Activator set. As of September 2026 this is the only registered item. A registration confirms that the market-access procedure has been carried out; it is not a confirmation of efficacy.

content.exportNote: The company is open to Latin American and North American markets. It is ready to discuss both finished products and the supply of exosomes as a raw material for third-party formulations.
